data.body: Idea recorded in backlog_ideas.txt (repo root): an opt-in budget gate for a Chat — a field beside the composer, set before the first input is committed and frozen with the rest of the execution context, visible while set, with exhaustion taking a declared fallback/limit outcome rather than a provider failure; absent field means today's behaviour (no cap). It must cover agent-internal model-tool loops as well as graph loops. Open questions listed there: granularity (Chat/turn/node), what counts (provider calls, tokens, cost, wall clock), composer vs Run-details control, and how a resumed/steered Chat continues a partly consumed budget. Not scheduled; the user called it advanced polishing for later. Promote to an Adashi task or a design-element paragraph when it becomes real.
